casual.scene: At an empty observatory visitor terrace on a clear blue evening, leaning side-on against a low railing and looking back toward camera, one hand lightly adjusting a small orange sun-catching glass ornament resting on a shelf, the other resting open on the railing. Both complete hands inside the crop; stars beyond the terrace.
